topic: Lesson 27 Work Rate + syllabus review (未知因数／剩余／换算天数)
formulas: Missing factor: product ÷ known factor (未知因数：用除法验算)
Plan vs actual: compare daily rates (计划与实际)

questions.title: 按效率推算天数
questions.q: 王阿姨 6 天缝了 2160 件衣服。照这样的速度，缝 3240 件衣服需要几天？
questions.explanation: 先求每天的效率：2160 ÷ 6 = 360（件/天）。再求缝 3240 件需要的天数：3240 ÷ 360 = 9。所以需要 9 天。

wrong.B: 15 是把 2160+3240 再乱除，或把两段天数凑在一起。应先算效率 360 件/天，再 3240÷360=9。

questions.mistakes: 未先求效率就硬凑天数；把总件数相加再除。

questions.title: Remaining work
questions.q: There are 4860 bookmarks to make. Lucas makes 270 bookmarks per hour. After he works for 7 hours, how many bookmarks are left?
questions.explanation: Done in 7 hours: 270 × 7 = 1890 bookmarks. Remaining: 4860 − 1890 = 2970 bookmarks.

wrong.A: 1890 is how many he already made (270×7), not how many are left. Subtract from the total: 4860 − 1890 = 2970.
wrong.C: 4590 looks like 4860 − 270 (only one hour). He worked 7 hours, so subtract 1890.
wrong.D: 2430 is half of 4860. Use rate × time first: 270×7=1890, then 4860−1890=2970.

questions.mistakes: Reporting done amount instead of remaining; subtracting only one hour of work.

questions.title: 求时间
questions.q: 小明每小时做 165 个零件，做完 1980 个零件要几小时？
questions.explanation: 时间 = 工作量 ÷ 效率：1980 ÷ 165 = 12。所以要 12 小时。
questions.mistakes: 估商偏大或偏小；用加减代替除法。

questions.title: Missing factor
questions.q: What number belongs in the box? □ × 24 = 3552

wrong.A: 24 × 138 = 3312, which is short of 3552 (short by 240). Try a larger quotient: 148.
wrong.C: 24 × 158 = 3792, which is past 3552. The quotient is too big; use 148.
wrong.D: 24 × 146 = 3504, only 48 short of 3552. One more step of 24 gives 148. (Yesterday □×18=2628 needed 146 — different problem.)

questions.mistakes: Underestimating the quotient; stopping one step short when checking with multiplication.

questions.title: 算式对应问题

options.A: 李师傅 8 天做了 2880 个零件，照此速度做完 7200 个一共要几天？
options.B: 李师傅 8 天做了 2880 个零件。已经做了 8 天，照此速度做完还剩的 7200−2880 个零件，还要几天？
options.C: 李师傅每小时做 2880 个零件，做 8 小时一共做多少个？
options.D: 7200 个零件，8 个人一起做，每人做多少个？

questions.explanation: 先算效率：2880 ÷ 8 = 360（个/天）。再算剩余：7200 − 2880 = 4320。最后 4320 ÷ 360 = 12，就是「已做 8 天后，剩余还要几天」。算式结构正好是（总量−已做）÷（已做÷天数）。

wrong.C: 那是乘法：2880×8，与这个除法算式无关。
wrong.D: 那是 7200÷8，没有用到 2880，也不符合算式结构。

questions.mistakes: 把「剩余天数」误当成「总天数」；忽略算式里的减法。

questions.title: Plan vs actual
questions.q: A factory planned to make 8640 toys in 12 days (same number each day). They finished all 8640 toys in only 8 days. How many MORE toys per day did they make than planned?
questions.explanation: Planned rate = 8640 ÷ 12 = 720 toys per day. Actual rate = 8640 ÷ 8 = 1080 toys per day. Difference = 1080 − 720 = 360 more toys per day.

wrong.A: 720 is the planned daily amount, not how many more than the plan. Subtract: 1080 − 720 = 360.
wrong.B: 1080 is the actual daily amount. The question asks how many more than planned: 1080 − 720 = 360.
wrong.D: 240 may come from (12−8)×60 or another mix-up. Find both daily rates first, then subtract.

questions.mistakes: Reporting plan or actual rate instead of the difference; using day difference without rates.
